/.title: Eileen Kolster
/.description: Eileen Kolster is a British/Dutch composer based in Amsterdam, writing for film, documentary and games. She is a violinist and pianist, and her music ranges from intimate acoustic and ambient textures to expansive orchestral and synth-driven soundscapes.
